card.name: The word ready in ready-to-use products
card.fires_on: The word "ready" in phrases like "is ready to use" or "premixed, ready to administer", where a product is supplied needing no dilution or preparation.

modes.label: Ready to use
modes.description: "ready" after "is" or "supplied as" describing a solution that needs no dilution.
modes.example: SARCLISA ESCENA is<< ready>> to use and should not be diluted.

modes.label: Premixed, ready
modes.description: "ready" after "premixed," in descriptions of supplied containers.
modes.example: These presentations contain a premixed,<< ready>> to use dexmedetomidine hydro

modes.label: Must be prepared
modes.description: The word "be" in a mixture that must be prepared fresh, a rarer related case.
modes.example: The mixture must<< be>> prepared fresh for each dose and taken within
